subject: PAGE directive
notes: Rule: 'If a source listing is not being produced, a PAGE directive shall have no effect.' (cite.py --check 7.3.19.4 -> OK §7.3.19.4 3)). No listing is ever produced; Render replaces the PAGE line with a blank line and applies no state (DirectiveStateRegistry holds nothing for PAGE). Probes out/probe/page-directive/p1.cob (fixed form: bare >>PAGE before IDENTIFICATION, >>PAGE between headers and inside a statement sequence, lowercase >>page) and p2.cob (free form, >>PAGE between statements) run with the output the program has without the directives (ONE/TWO1; OK) at 2002 and 2023. Goldens pb725_directive_facility (2002, comment cites 7.3.19.4 GR3) and pb794_directive_operands (2023) contain >>PAGE with directive-independent expected output.
